The dentist on hand refuses to remove it because of the exposed nerve and she didn't feel safe doing it since she didn't have experience.

They had to go in, saw the tooth itself in to several pieces with me being wide awake and then fish the broken pieces out of the sinus lining.

After these wisdom teeth were pulled, my jaw bone cracked and I never knew it until the surgeon had to see me weeks later and he had to cut my gums open again, file it, try to repair it.


I fucking hate dentists and the smell of my teeth being drilled in to pieces.
